name: DGX Spark Networking
description: RoCE collectives, patched NCCL profiles, topology discovery, and fabric probes for multi-node DGX Spark inference.
compatibility: Two-node direct, three-node triangle, and four-node ring fabrics over ConnectX-7 200 GbE; one GPU and tensor-parallel rank per node.
One-shot RDMA all-reduce and all-gather, CUDA graphs, and NCCL 2.30.7 with packaged patches.
Ships a device communicator for the Local Inference Lab vLLM fork used by spark-ds41f.
limitations: Documented node stack includes DGX Spark OS 26.09+, kernel 7.0.0-1019-nvidia with kho=off, driver 580.178.04, ConnectX-7 firmware 28.45.4028, and rdma-core 50.

Needs MTU 9000, static IPv4 per cable stripe, GID index 3, unlimited locked memory, libibverbs headers, and a C compiler. Container recipes require NVIDIA runtime, host networking, RDMA devices, and IPC_LOCK.
One-shot runtime needs torch, cuda-python, and TileLang 0.1.15+; every NCCL profile requires a rebuilt library with the packaged send-path fence patch to avoid hangs.
No adapter ships for upstream vLLM or SGLang. Switched 2-16-node profiles are configuration paths not qualified on the author's fleet; GPU-initiated transport is not implemented.
Does not configure hosts or supervise serving. Probe and benchmark each fabric before use; collective failures require restarting the rank group.

sources.note: Describes collectives, supported fabrics, fork-specific integration, qualification status, and unfinished GPU-initiated transport.
Lists qualified OS, kernel, driver, firmware, network, locked-memory, and container prerequisites.
Documents runtime dependencies, mandatory NCCL patches, engine integration boundaries, probes, and rank-group failure handling.
